18. RESOLUTION ~ Re-appropriating the Fiscal Year 2023 Budget of the City of Cheyenne
according to the provisions of W.S. §§ 16-4-112 & 16-4-113. (SPONSOR ~ MR.
WHITE)

Dr. Aldrich moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Roybal. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote,

Robin Lockman, City Treasurer, provided a staff report. Eric Fountain, Compliance Director, and

Jason Sanchez, Community Recreation & Events Director, provided additional information

Committee member Aldrich commented on the item,

19, RESOLUTION ~ Expressing the support of the Governing Body for the establishment of
an Urban Renewal Authority Fiduciary Fund. (SPONSOR ~ MR. WHITE)

Dr. Aldrich moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Roybal. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.
Robin Lockman, City Treasurer, provided a staff report.

2) Grant Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and the Federal Transit
‘Administration to fund Transit Operations. (FTA Section 5307 Grant)
